composition_subtypes.role: iterates over all node pairs, DFS/BFS to get path and sizes

payload.core_composition_summary: Complete search over O(n^2) pairs, using DFS/BFS for path and subtree sizes, then combinatorial formula.
payload.rationale: No DP used; solution enumerates all pairs and computes probability via graph traversal and combinatorics, thus a single mechanism (complete search).
